findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露 Shopify 定位為多通路商務平台，銷售通路含線上店、實體零售、AI 平台、社群；營收由訂閱方案與商家成功型（merchant solutions）兩部分構成
findings.excerpt: Shopify offers them the tools to seamlessly manage, market and sell their products across various sales channels, including online storefronts, physical retail spaces, AI platforms, social media and more.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A 將「提供更多銷售通路」及運用 AI 等新技術列為未來成功要素
findings.excerpt: offer more sales channels that connect merchants with potential customers; develop new solutions to extend our platform’s functionality and catalyze merchants’ sales growth; leverage emerging technologies, including AI;

channel_business_model_shift.note: 另見搜尋線索：2026-03-24 Agentic Storefronts 對美國商家上線（ChatGPT/Copilot/Google AI Mode/Perplexity）、Q3 2026 營收組合偏向 merchant solutions（Payments 滲透率 68%）；皆為聚合站摘要未取得逐字原文，列於 clues。
